speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to help me understand your condition, please tell me when these episodes started and how long each episode typically lasts.

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The key features here are your age, the sudden onset, and most importantly, the fact that your dizziness is strictly position-dependent. This pattern strongly suggests crystals in the inner ear, known as BPPV. Do you notice that the spinning sensation occurs specifically when you roll over in bed or look up?
